summary: Aggregates per-wheel force outputs from six indexed parameter triples (index times multiplier plus base) read from the owning physics object, feeds them into polynomial, tire-force, quadratic, and linear force models, and sums the model outputs into the lateral component *a3 and the longitudinal component *a4.

operations.description: Evaluate parameter triple A as index this+0xE04 times multiplier this+0xDF8 plus base this+0xDF0, producing the polynomial input v9.
Evaluate QuadraticCubicPolynomialEvaluator on the triple-A input, filling outputs v12 and v18.
Evaluate parameter triple B as index this+0xE44 times multiplier this+0xE38 plus base this+0xE30, producing the polynomial input v10.
Evaluate QuadraticCubicPolynomialEvaluator on the triple-B input, filling outputs a2[0] and v17.
Evaluate parameter triple C as index this+0x1284 times multiplier this+0x1278 plus base this+0x1270, producing the tire-force input v7.
Run TireForceTorqueComputation on the triple-C input with time step 0.025, filling outputs v21 and v16.
Evaluate parameter triple D as index this+0x12C4 times multiplier this+0x12B8 plus base this+0x12B0, producing the quadratic-model input v11.
Run QuadraticForceModel on the triple-D input, filling outputs v20 and v15.
Evaluate parameter triple E as index this+0x1304 times multiplier this+0x12F8 plus base this+0x12F0, producing the linear-model input v8.
Evaluate parameter triple F as index this+0x1344 times multiplier this+0x1338 plus base this+0x1330, producing the second linear-model input v6.
Run LinearVehicleParameterEvaluation with inputs v6 and v8 and time step 0.025, filling outputs v19 and v14.
Run QuadraticForceTorqueCurveEvaluation with time step 0.025, filling output v13.
Sum the lateral components v19[2] + v20[2] + v21[2] + a2[0] + v12 into the output *a3.
Sum the longitudinal components v13 + v14 + v15 + v16 + v17 + v18 into the output *a4.
Return the output pointer a4 as the result.

unresolved: The owning object class is unproven; the read offsets are consistent with a per-wheel physics parameter block but the packet does not name the owner.
Which physical wheel each of the six parameter triples (A through F) corresponds to, and the exact force semantics of the two summed outputs, are not established.
